d.ko: One Turn Kill is a PvE card game where card drawing and deck control are the keys to victory. Engage in battles limited to a single turn for an exhilarating, suspenseful experience.Join the protagonist in a pixel art wasteland to face off with the strongest of enemies and see what story awaits.

d.zh:
『One Turn Kill』是一款由抽卡与牌组掌控来决定胜局的PvE型卡牌游戏。战斗被限制在一回合内，刺激的出牌过程给人带来欲罢不能的爽快感。
游戏里你将来到一片像素美术描绘的荒凉世界，与主角一起对抗强敌并成为结局的见证者。
